01Why now

Why this course, and why now

Most architecture problems are decisions nobody wrote down, made against goals nobody measured. At this level you learn to state quality in numbers, compare options against them, and leave a record that people and AI coding tools can both follow.

02Outcomes

What you will be able to do

Measure quality

Write quality scenarios with numbers for speed, availability, security and cost.

Decide with evidence

Compare options against your scenarios and choose with the trade-offs in plain sight.

Record decisions

Write decision records that a new team member, or an AI agent, can act on.

Review a design

Test a design against its own scenarios and find the weak spots before they ship.

04The lab

Your quality and decisions record

Take the system you documented at Level 1 and add what it was missing: measured quality goals and the decisions behind it. One project, built in steps after each lesson. Each step has instructions, a finished example, a health check, and saves on your device.

The steps

  1. Build a quality tree with numbers
  2. Write six quality scenarios
  3. Choose three decisions and list the options for each
  4. Write the decision records
  5. Run a trade-off review against your scenarios
  6. Write the risks you found and what you will do

What the health check looks for

  • Every quality goal has a number
  • Every decision lists at least two options and why one lost
  • Every scenario can be tested
